title: Qawa'id al-Ahkam fi Ma'rifat al-Halal wa al-Haram
originalTitle: قواعد الأحكام في معرفة الحلال والحرام
author: al-allama-al-hilli
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-'Allama al-Hilli's comprehensive statement of Twelver law, setting out the questions of each topic with the alternatives open to the jurist. Its systematic coverage made it, with his uncle's Shara'i', the basis of later Shia legal scholarship.
historicalContext: Al-'Allama al-Hilli was the nephew and student of al-Muhaqqiq al-Hilli and the most prolific Shia scholar of the Ilkhanid period; his influence at the court of Oljeitu helped establish Twelver Shi'ism in Iran.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
